english.title: Taxi driver fail to leave taxi feeder park Manchester Airport as directed and proceed to authorised standing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 6.17 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a taxi driver
who was, for the time being, in a taxi feeder park at Manchester Airport
failed to leave that park by an exit
for the time being designated for that purpose
and in the order in which you entered immediately
when required to do so by a constable / airport official and
proceed directly and
without delay to the authorised standing
